newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse posts modest gain in improved volume.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse posts modest gain in improved volume.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange on Monday held on to its modest gains from last week with volume markedly improved.
The GSE All-Share Index closed 0.43 points higher at 359.39 on turnover of 366,340 shares compared with last Friday's 52,470. Offers outpaced bids 827,640 to 543,220.

Ashanti Goldfields Co Ltd, the market's leading bluechip, gained 100 cedis to close at 21,200 cedis, followed by Unilever up five cedis to 775 cedis. The only loser, Aluworks Ltd dipped five cedis to 1,340 cedis.
